objective: Determine whether V16 produces no actionable candidate because final baseball inputs are unavailable, the upstream intrinsic-thesis gate suppresses price discovery, executable price is unavailable, price removes the edge, or a downstream operating-envelope blocker rejects a positive-EV market.

requiredDiagnosticSeparation.sportsPrediction: Expose the V16 settlement probabilities for every scored FINAL game without using price to alter them.
requiredDiagnosticSeparation.bettingEconomics: Separately expose discovery eligibility, price availability, EV classification and operating-envelope disposition.
requiredDiagnosticSeparation.upstreamGateAudit: A FINAL game scored by V16 but lacking a discovery plan must be visible as an intrinsic-thesis suppression rather than being mislabeled as a market-price failure.

decisionRule: Do not loosen any gate from a short no-play observation. First measure the full funnel and identify the earliest blocker for each FINAL scored game. Any later architecture change requires separate evidence and authorization.
